t: 摩尔达维亚的斯蒂芬三世在瓦斯卢伊战役中击败了奥斯曼帝国.
te: Stephen III of Moldavia defeats the Ottoman Empire at the Battle of Vaslui.
dz: 摩尔达维亚的斯蒂芬三世在瓦斯卢伊战役中击败了奥斯曼帝国.
de: Stephen III of Moldavia defeats the Ottoman Empire at the Battle of Vaslui.

t: 皮基尼条约正式结束了法国和英国之间的战争。
te: The Treaty of Picquigny formally ends the war between the kingdoms of France and England.
dz: 百年战争：皮基尼条约正式结束了法国和英国之间的战争。
de: Hundred Years' War: The Treaty of Picquigny formally ends the war between the kingdoms of France and England.
